# WITH DANAYA

> WITH DANAYA is Danaya Yerzhanova's practical social-courage and relationship-coaching practice. It helps thoughtful adults—especially men navigating dating—build real-life communication, friendship, boundaries and connection through rehearsal and honest feedback.

Canonical website: https://withdanaya.com/
Contact: chart@withdanaya.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/danaya_papaya/
Language: English

## What the practice covers

- Social courage and practical social-skills rehearsal
- Adult friendship and social connection
- Dating and relationship coaching for thoughtful men
- Voice, delivery and nonverbal communication
- Boundaries, difficult conversations and relationship repair
- High-touch support around real-life social situations

## Important scope

WITH DANAYA provides coaching, rehearsal, feedback and accountability. It is not psychotherapy, couples therapy, medical care, diagnosis, crisis support or a substitute for licensed mental-health treatment.

Danaya Yerzhanova and WITH DANAYA are not affiliated with Esther Perel or Matthew Hussey. Their work is discussed only to explain the wider relationship-education landscape and the distinct role of Danaya's practice.

## Core ideas

- People need people.
- Social courage is trainable.
- Like any muscle, social courage weakens when it goes unused.
- Real-life social skill grows through small, repeatable reps.
- Good dating guidance should increase honest participation, not teach manipulation.
- Relationships can be restorative without being therapy.
